title: Private Deployments - Weekly Update 2026-06-29
content:
Weekly sync (Mon 2026-06-29) - Private Deployments
Attendees: Ayesha, Liam, Maria, Ravi, Sophia, Jordan, (brief: SRE on call)

TL;DR:
- Acme Financial VPC install still blocked by cross-account route propagation and customer NAT gateway config (blocker for go-live). PD-4123 assigned to Liam; next update EOD Wed.
- Zephyr Health on-prem installer failing on driver mismatch (NVIDIA driver + CUDA). Hotfix branch merged; QA validation scheduled Tue.
- KMS integration: design decision to require explicit grant-per-deployment to reduce blast radius; draft PR for doc updates and installer flags.
- Automated network tests for VPC peering added to CI; flakey in China regions, looking into routing tables and MTU differences.

Standup notes / individual updates:
- Ayesha (owner): Coordinating Acme go-live with Solutions Eng. Spoke with customer infra lead; they closed a subnet overlap issue but still seeing route propagation delays from their VPC-to-VPN tunnel. Raised PD-4123. Action: escalate to cloud provider contacts if no progress by Wed EOD.

- Liam (platform): Working PD-4123 (route propagation + policy mismatch). Reproduced routing problem in staging with a simulated cross-account VPN. Patch ready to alter our route announcement timing and to add a fallback static route option. Will test fallback path tomorrow.

- Maria (installer): Investigated Zephyr installer failure (driver mismatch). Root cause: customer running older NVIDIA driver (515) while installer expects 535+. Created hotfix branch (PR #724) that detects driver and offers a compatible container image + install flag --skip-driver-check for advanced users. QA scheduled Tue.

- Ravi (security): KMS grant model proposal reviewed by security; recommended explicit per-deployment grants + short-lived service accounts. Working on a confluence doc and sample Terraform snippet. Action: finish docs by Thu. Linked to PD-4107.

- Sophia (SRE): Added automated CI test for VPC peering (integration test that verifies route table entries + iperf basic connectivity). Flakey in ap-east-1 (China-equivalent). Next: add MTU check and packet capture to triage.

- Jordan (solutions engineering): Onboarding checklist for Dedicated vs Private clarified; adding extra pre-checks for customers (NAT, DNS, route tables) into the installer preflight. Draft checklist available in linked Confluence page.

Customer blockers (current high-priority):
1) Acme Financial (Blocker): cross-account route propagation and VPN NAT config preventing traffic to private deployment. Impact: prevents scheduled go-live 2026-06-30. Owner: Liam. Mitigation ideas: temporary host route configuration, cloud provider support case, schedule maintenance window with customer. JIRA:PD-4123.

2) Zephyr Health (High): installer fails when GPU drivers older than expected. Impact: cannot complete on-prem validation. Owner: Maria. Hotfix PR merged; QA pending. JIRA:PD-4107, PR:#724.

3) Internal: CI flakiness for VPC tests in ap-east-1 causing false negatives on rollout gating. Owner: Sophia. Working to add additional checks and rerun. JIRA:INFRA-523.

Action items and owners:
- Liam: Validate fallback static route implementation in staging and deliver test results by 2026-06-30. If unresolved, open provider escalation.
- Maria: Complete QA run for driver hotfix and prepare release artifact + release notes by 2026-06-30.
- Ravi: Finalize KMS grant model doc and Terraform sample; circulate to security and legal by 2026-07-01.
- Sophia: Add MTU and packet-capture steps to VPC test and re-run CI for ap-east-1 by 2026-06-30.
- Jordan: Add installer preflight NAT/DNS checks to checklist and share with Solutions Eng template by 2026-07-02.
- Ayesha: Coordinate escalation plan with Account Exec and schedule contingency maintenance window for Acme.

Open design discussions we touched on:
- KMS integration: consensus leans to per-deployment grants + explicit customer acceptance. Need follow-up on UX for managed vs bring-your-own keys (BYOK).
- Installer UX: offer safe default to fail-fast on driver mismatches but expose an opt-in path for advanced customers (discussed tradeoffs).
- Network testing: investigate adding an e2e lab in ap-east-1 to reduce flakiness vs adding more robust test instrumentation.

Notes / misc:
- Customer feedback: Acme requested clearer pre-install list for VPN/NAT requirements 1) Jordan to add to onboarding.
- Billing: no impact this week.
- Risks: if Acme cannot get route propagation fixed in time, we need to delay go-live and inform Sales; prepare a rollback/standdown checklist.

Next meeting: Weekly sync Tue 2026-07-06 09:30 PT (note week shift for holiday). Please update Jira tickets with status before the meeting.

Attachments / artifacts: see linked_artifacts for PR, Jira, Confluence runbook and checklist.
